_comment: Claude Code settings owned by the harness. The generator merges this file with
`modelPicker` and `env` computed from models.yaml and writes the result to
generated/managed-settings.json; the entrypoint installs it as the drop-in
These are MANAGED settings: they win over user and project settings.
Keep here what does not follow from model definitions: hooks, permissions, statusLine.
Keys computed from models.yaml win over this file.
MCP servers do NOT go here - see claude/mcp.json (managed settings accept
only http/sse servers and reject stdio).
